outcome: acceptance of vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC)
cohort: Pregnant women with a previous history of cesarean section meeting Royal College of Obstetrics and Gynecology criteria at Shree Birendra Hospital in Kathmandu, Nepal.
finding: The acceptance of vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC) was very low (11.8%) among pregnant women with a prior cesarean section.
mod_finding: 50% of women who attempted a trial of labor after cesarean section had a successful vaginal birth, with fewer complications compared to the repeat cesarean section group.
